caption:
Global Metadata: A soulful Greek bouzouki piece, 100 BPM, passionate and melodic. Led by the bouzouki (a long-necked plucked lute) with its bright, ringing, metallic plucked tone, joined by a light percussion and an acoustic bass. A warm male voice sings a lyrical Greek verse, the bouzouki answers with fast bright ornamented phrases, and the ensemble builds to a passionate refrain before a spirited ending. Production profile: warm, close Mediterranean recording, bright ringing bouzouki, crisp percussion, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: One lead voice, a passionate warm male singer in Greek, natural, no auto-tune, expressive. No falsetto, no backing choir, no spoken dialogue. The voice is absent in the instrumental breaks.

Arrangement: Intro, the bouzouki plays a bright ringing motif over the percussion and bass. Verse one, the warm male voice sings a lyrical Greek verse, the bouzouki answers. Refrain, the ensemble builds to a passionate refrain with the voice. Section two, a bouzouki instrumental with fast ornamented phrases. Outro, a spirited ending.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Bouzouki bright ringing motif, percussion and bass

[Verse 1]
Μια καρδιά στο Αιγαίο
to bouzouki klaiei me emena
σου λέω, αγάπη μου
ta fengaria mou tha latho

[Refrain]
Xorepse, xorepse me
i zoi einai mia ora
opou ki an pas, na thimasai
na tragoudas gia mena

[Section 2]
Bouzouki instrumental, fast ornamented phrases

[Outro]
A spirited passionate ending
